title: Fly into Salt Lake City
summary: Meet the others at the airport, In-N-Out, downtown on foot, then north to Logan for the night.
drive: Salt Lake City to Logan · 1h 20m · 130 km

segments.name: Segment 1 — Landing, the car, and In-N-Out
segments.blurb: The early group collects the car and waits; first meal together once you land.

map.from: Salt Lake City International Airport, Utah
map.to: In-N-Out Burger, 28 E 2100 S, South Salt Lake, Utah

stops.name: Salt Lake City International Airport
stops.q: Salt Lake City International Airport terminal

stops.name: Rental car counters, Gateway Center
stops.q: Salt Lake City International Airport terminal
stops.note: Counters and cars are in the garage, no shuttle.

stops.name: In-N-Out Burger, South Salt Lake
stops.note: 28 E 2100 S — the closest branch to downtown.

expect.arrive: Landside is simple here: baggage claim, one skywalk, and the rental counters sit in the garage directly opposite with the cars parked behind them, so nobody waits for a bus.
expect.parking: Whoever lands first can have the car and the luggage loaded before your flight is even on the ground.
expect.need: 1-2 hours from your landing to leaving lunch

paths.do: Car collected early, everyone meets at baggage claim, one drive out to In-N-Out together.
If your flight slips badly, the early group eats first and you meet them at the restaurant.
Straight downtown if the day is already gone — In-N-Out is open until 1:30am on a Friday if you want it later.

segments.name: Segment 2 — Salt Lake City on foot
segments.blurb: Downtown and Capitol Hill, once everyone is together.

map.center: Temple Square, Salt Lake City, Utah

stops.name: Ensign Peak
stops.note: Short hike, skyline and valley overlook.

trail.from: Ensign Peak Nature Park trailhead, 1002 N Ensign Vista Dr

stops.name: Temple Square
stops.note: Historic LDS temple complex, city center.

expect.arrive: Downtown Salt Lake City is flat and walkable; Temple Square and the Capitol both have their own free lots, Ensign Peak's trailhead lot is a small gravel pull-in in a residential street.
expect.parking: Temple Square and Capitol lots are large and rarely full midday; Ensign Peak's lot holds maybe 15 cars and street parking fills on weekends.

paths.do: Walk the plaza, Assembly Hall exterior, and grounds.
Temple Square, then drive up to the Capitol steps and rotunda.
Capitol, Temple Square, plus the short climb up Ensign Peak for the skyline view.

segments.name: Segment 3 — Dinner, Trader Joe's, and the drive to Logan
segments.blurb: Dinner downtown, a shop stop, then north up the canyon.

stops.name: Osteria Amore (dinner)
stops.q: Salt Lake City downtown restaurant street
stops.note: Dinner stop in Salt Lake City.

stops.name: Trader Joe's, 634 E 400 S
stops.note: Road snacks for the parks. Open until 9pm.

stops.name: Logan Canyon
stops.note: Canyon drive into Logan, evening arrival.

expect.arrive: Trader Joe's sits on the east side of downtown with its own small lot, about ten minutes back to I-15; Logan Canyon beyond Sardine Summit is a dark two-lane highway at that hour.
expect.parking: The Trader Joe's lot is tight and awkward at teatime; there is street parking on 400 South.
expect.need: 2 hours in town, then 1h 20m of driving

paths.do: Skip the sit-down, grab dinner and road food at Trader Joe's in one stop.
Osteria Amore, then Trader Joe's on the way out — it closes at 9pm, so order early.
Trader Joe's only, drive north on an empty stomach and eat when you arrive.

alt: Downtown Salt Lake City restaurant row evening
segments.seasonal: Trader Joe's at 634 E 400 S closes at 9pm daily (traderjoes.com, read 2026-09-17), and it is the last decent shop before the parks — Logan has supermarkets but nothing in Grand Teton does.
